capture_metadata.label: phase2c-r1
fixture_limits: Production scene and player camera with debug travel, healing, day/phase pins and aftermath fixture; not earned progression proof.
Arrival is the southern route approach at [-350,315], not the exact spawn/entry gate.
Legacy chapter matrix records camera position but not basis; no numerical orientation comparison is claimed.
Pocket fixture pins Calm and sets stormwood:rootgate_released; this is not an earned gate-state proof.
Static environment-only frames omit ordinary combat HUD, 720p stress, movement and device performance; full chapter acceptance remains incomplete.
